accuracy.forgetting_definition: Mean over old tasks 1..9 of max accuracy after acquisition through task9 minus accuracy after task10; improvements remain negative.

resources.scope: Whole Recorder includes preparation, training, prototypes, evaluation and audits; final artifact upload/finish excluded. Task interval ends after evaluation/checkpoint audit before task Slack/logging. Phase times are inclusive.
resources.energy_scope: Selected GPU-board sampled power integral; CPU/RAM and total-machine energy are unmeasured.
resources.memory_scope: Per-task CUDA peaks are reset; process peak preserves initialization and all tasks. NVML/RSS peaks are sampled; summed process-tree RSS can duplicate shared pages.

work_counts.scope: Saved image exposure and adapter-image pair counters; a pair counts one image through one adapter subspace. Repeated frozen-backbone passes are method work, not unique images, FLOPs or equal compute budgets.

compatibility.scope: All ten raw train/test populations, observed post-begin-task transforms, first training batches, checkpoint, seed/batch/workers/GPU and eight recorded precision policies. The EASE train RNG matches HiDe TII; HiDe prompt-stage augmentation and all phase budgets remain method-specific.

comparison.schedule_scope: EASE20 epochs/task vs HiDe TII20+prompt50 and CA30/task2 onward; single seed and different optimization work.
